dialogues.speaker: Smirnova
dialogues.text: Oh, I'm sorry. I was quite lost in thought just then... Is there something you want to ask?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You look a bit worn out...

dialogues.speaker: Smirnova
dialogues.text: Thank you for your concern... I'm actually doing much better now.

dialogues.speaker: Smirnova
dialogues.text: A while back, there was an incident while I was stationed in Nod-Krai... Command granted me special leave to go home and rest up for a while.

dialogues.speaker: Smirnova
dialogues.text: It's just... I can't help but worry about Captain Volkov and the others.

dialogues.speaker: Smirnova
dialogues.text: Thank you. May Her Majesty's glory protect you as well.

dialogues.speaker: Smirnova
dialogues.text: Hmm... I suppose it's alright to tell you. You seem like a good person...

dialogues.speaker: Smirnova
dialogues.text: I'm a Private in the 6th Company deployed to Nod-Krai in service to the Fatui. We were assigned to secure the Kuuvahki experiments conducted by two professors from the Design Bureau.

dialogues.speaker: Smirnova
dialogues.text: But... a terrible accident occurred out there. Captain Volkov and Orlov stayed behind so I could get out and bring back help.

dialogues.speaker: Smirnova
dialogues.text: Officials from the Armory Palace told me later that they've already taken control of the area. My Captain and the others must still be alive. They just need time to find them...

dialogues.speaker: Smirnova
dialogues.text: I have to get well soon. When they make it back safe and sound...
